name: Do I need to hire a contractor specializing in water damage, or can a general contractor handle it?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to hire a contractor specializing in water damage, or can a general contractor handle it?

acceptedAnswer.text: While a general contractor can perform many repairs, water-damaged exterior repair often benefits from a contractor with specialized experience in identifying moisture intrusion points and remediation. Such specialists understand the nuances of waterproofing, proper drainage, and selecting appropriate materials for long-term prevention. A key decision factor is the complexity: simple surface repairs might suit a general contractor, but underlying structural or mold issues typically require a specialized approach to ensure thorough and lasting solutions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Complex water damage benefits from a specialized contractor who understands moisture intrusion and waterproofing, whereas simple repairs might suit a general contractor.
